cumulative evaluator suite:\n//   - GET without a match -> 405 Method Not Allowed (body is not read)\n//   - POST without a match -> body is read, then 404 Not Found\n//   - any other HTTP method -> return router;\n  }\n\n  async function handle(req, res) {\n    const { method, url } = req;\n\n    for (const route of routes) {\n      if (route.method !== method) continue;\n      const match = url.match(route.pattern);\n      if (match) {\n        if (method === 'POST') {\n          req.body = await readBody(req);\n        }\n        // Spread captured groups so handlers receive each path segment as a\n        // separate positional argument (e.g., id, slug, campaignId).\n        return route.handler(req, res, ...match.slice(1));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (method !== 'POST') {\n post: (pattern, handler) => add('POST', pattern, handler),\n    handle,\n  };\n\n  return The `TABLE_NAMES` array is kept in dependency order so the reset path can drop child tables before parents.\n- **`lib/domain.js`** — Pure business logic and validation: dice parsing, encounter XP, initiative ordering, ability modifiers, proficiency bonus, auth hashing, and shared validation helpers (`isNonEmptyString`, `isPositiveInteger`, `isValidSlug`, etc.). Shared constants such as `ABILITY_NAMES` live here.\n- **`lib/http.js`** — Shared HTTP utilities: body reading, JSON responses, and common error helpers (`badRequest`, `unauthorized`, `notFound`, `methodNotAllowed`, `conflict`).\n- **`lib/handlers.js`** — HTTP request handlers, organized by domain (health, storage, auth, dice, checks, characters, PHB rules, combat, compendium, campaigns, and DM helpers). Combat handlers share small private helpers (`activeCombatant`, `publicOrder`, `publicCondition`, `publicConditions`) to keep response formatting consistent.\n- **`run.sh`** — Foreground startup script.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence\n\n- SQLite database file: `game.db` in the project root.\n- Schema version is fixed at `1` and exposed via `/v1/storage/status`.\n- Tables: `users`, `combat_sessions`, `monsters`, `items`, `campaigns`, `characters`, `events`, `factions`, `npcs`, `quests`, `campaign_inventory`, `character_equipment`, `crafting_projects`, `campaign_sessions`, `session_attendance`, `play_campaigns`, `play_members`, `play_narrations`.\n- JSON arrays/objects (initiative order, combat conditions, monster tags) are serialized to `TEXT` columns with `JSON.stringify`/`JSON.parse`.\n- `/v1/storage/reset` drops all tables and recreates them. This is the only destructive endpoint and is intended for tests. The drop order follows the dependency order in `lib/db.js` so foreign-key constraints are satisfied.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`server.js` builds a `Router` from `lib/router.js`. Routes are evaluated in registration order, and the first matching method/pattern wins. Parameterized routes are placed before more general parents so they are not accidentally shadowed.\n\nThe router preserves the following behavior, which the cumulative evaluator suite depends on:\n\n- `GET` without a matching route returns `405 Method Not Allowed` and does not read the body.\n- `POST` without a matching route reads the body, then returns `404 Not Found`.\n- Any other HTTP method returns `405 Method Not Allowed` without reading the body.\n\n`POST` handlers receive the raw body on `req.body` as a string. Handlers parse it with `lib/http.js::parseJson` via `lib/handlers.js::requireBody`. Invalid JSON returns `400 invalid json`.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Purpose |\n|-------|-----------|---------|\n| **Health** | `GET /health` | Liveness check. |\n| **Storage** | `GET /v1/storage/status`, `POST /v1/storage/reset` | SQLite status and reset. |\n| **Auth** | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login` | User accounts with `scrypt` password hashing. |\n| **Core / Dice** | `POST /v1/dice/stats`, `POST /v1/checks/ability`, `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `POST /v1/initiative/order` | Dice stats, ability checks, encounter XP, initiative. /v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | Create session, add conditions, advance turns. |\n| **Compendium** | `POST /v1/compendium/monsters`, `GET narration, player actions, and GM resolution. |\n\n## Conventions for safely extending and testing the codebase\n\n- **Keep handlers thin**: handlers validate input, call `lib/db.js` or `lib/domain.js`, and format responses. Business rules belong in `lib/domain.js`.\n- **Add routes in order**: new routes go into the `createRouter()` chain in `server.js` in the order they should be checked. Place parameterized routes before general ones that could shadow them.\n- **Use the shared validation helpers**: prefer `domain.isNonEmptyString`, `domain.isPositiveInteger`, `domain.isNonNegativeInteger`, `domain.isValidSlug`, `domain.isStringArray`, and `domain.ABILITY_NAMES` for consistent error messages and shapes.\n- **Preserve response shapes and status codes**: existing endpoints have fixed response bodies required by the cumulative test suite. Any changes must keep status codes and JSON keys identical.\n- **Centralize schema changes**: when adding or changing tables, update `lib/db.js` only. Keep `TABLE_NAMES` in dependency order so `resetDb()` remains safe.\n- **JSON bodies**: all handlers use `requireBody` from `lib/handlers.js`, which wraps `lib/http.js::parseJson`. Invalid JSON returns `400 invalid json`.\n- **Errors**: `badRequest` → `400 { error }`, `unauthorized` → `401 { error }`, `notFound` → `404 { error: 'not found' }`, `methodNotAllowed` → `405 { error: 'method not allowed' }`, `conflict` → `409 { error }`. Uncaught errors log to stderr and return `500 { error: 'internal server error' }`.\n- **No external dependencies**: do not add npm packages or TypeScript. The project uses only Node.js stdlib modules and plain `.js` ES modules (`\"type\": \"module\"` in `package.json`).\n- **Determinism**: avoid randomness in business logic. The only randomness is `crypto.randomBytes` when generating password salts.\n- **Combat condition formatting**: when exposing conditions in responses, use the shared `publicCondition` / `publicConditions` helpers so the shape stays consistent across endpoints.\n\n## Testing locally\n\nStart the server, reset storage, then exercise endpoints:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh &\nSERVER=$!\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/storage/reset\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/dice/stats -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"expression\":\"2d6+3\"}'\nkill $SERVER\n```\n"}],"isError":false,"timestamp":1785462895241},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"Need add feature.
